title: Hard access conflict and reasonable inference

finding.title: The locker opens without its only key
finding.summary: The draft establishes one key, keeps it on Maya, and then shows the undamaged locker open.
finding.question: Is the locker opening without the only key intentional?
finding.conflicting_fact_a: Nora says there is only one key and Maya keeps it.
finding.conflicting_fact_b: The locker is open while the key remains attached to Maya and there is no damage.
finding.inference_explanation: The draft supplies no visible alternate access path.

evidence.quote: Locker 214 stands open. The brass key is still attached to Maya's belt. There is no visible damage.
